verdict.line: You lose the lane if Irelia hits three or four unpunished Q resets before level 6; you win if you survive to Realm of Death and drag the fight into your itemized mid-game.

brief.thesis: Irelia vs Mordekaiser is a 45.3% winrate matchup over 499 games because Morde has no dash and only a 700-range pull to answer her mobile, stun-and-mark kit before level 6. Death's Grasp (E) is his only engage and it telegraphs hard, so early trades are on her terms. Realm of Death (R) at level 6 is the equalizer — it removes her from the fight on his terms and steals her stats, which is why the matchup stabilizes once both ultimates are live.

tell.watch: Irelia's Q cooldown and passive stacks

theirWindow.what: She dashes in for free damage and heal, then looks to land Flawless Duet (E) for the stun and Mark before you can react. Do not stand still after she Qs a minion near you — that's a free reset into your face.

yourWindow.when: her Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: This is your only real all-in window before level 6. Land Death's Grasp (E, 16s cooldown at rank 1) to pull her in, then Obliterate (Q) — the single-target damage bonus matters here since she's your only target.

powerCurve.note: Bladesurge dash and sustain beat your no-mobility kit

Realm of Death now threatens every all-in

start.item: Doran's Ring, Health Potion, Health Potion
start.why: This is the 66.1%-picked start (47.8% win rate over 427 games) and gives you the sustain to eat Bladesurge poke without losing lane HP permanently.

boots.why: 87.7% pick rate at 45.6% win rate — the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts her auto-attack resets and passive on-hit damage, which is how she actually kills you.

core.why: OP.GG's own tip names this as the first item — the healing reduction cuts her Bladesurge sustain and grievous wounds keeps her from stabilizing off her passive.
Appears in every listed core path (53.8-69.2% win rate) — the slow from Q and E makes it much harder for her to walk out of Death's Grasp range.
Second item in all three listed core paths — the omnivamp and true damage ramp let you win extended trades even after she's landed her stun.

situational.when: she is building on-hit or crit and out-DPSing your shield in extended fights
she is building tanky or you need more sustained DPS to close out slower duels

runes.keystoneWhy: This is the 53.9%-picked page for this matchup — the stacking adaptive damage and healing from Conqueror keeps you alive through her early poke and rewards the extended trades your kit is built for.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 78% of games at this matchup (45.6% win rate) — Ignite punishes her all-in healing from Bladesurge and gives you kill pressure once you land Death's Grasp.

playing.title: Never E on cooldown speculatively
playing.detail: Death's Grasp is your only engage tool at 16-14-12-10-8s cooldown across ranks — whiffing it into an empty lane just hands her a free trading window while you wait it out.

playing.title: Trade only when both her Q and E are down
playing.detail: Bladesurge resets on minion or champion kill, so check the minion wave state before you commit — if she can reset off a low-HP caster, your trade math is wrong.

playing.title: Hold Indestructible for her stun window
playing.detail: W stores damage taken to build a shield you can consume to heal — pop it right after she lands Flawless Duet's stun so the healing lands while she's dumping damage into you.

playing.title: Play for level 6 all-ins
playing.detail: Realm of Death at 140-120-100-90-80s cooldown removes her from the lane fight entirely and steals her stats — this is your first real chance to flip a duel she was winning.

playing.title: Track Darkness Rise for trade timing
playing.detail: Your passive triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on her, granting a damage aura and move speed — time your all-in to start right as this procs, not before.

playing.title: Respect her charged W in extended fights
playing.detail: Defiant Dance deals more damage the longer she charges it and reduces the physical damage she takes while charging — don't commit your burst into a fully-charged W.

playing.title: Ban Bladesurge resets on lane minions
playing.detail: If she's sitting behind minions with Q up, she can dash-reset through the wave to burst you from a diagonal angle — hold position slightly off the direct minion line.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune page, boots, and all win-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tell timings and trade-window reasoning are my own read on the kits, not pulled from that data.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Bramble Vest first. Focus on dodging Irelia’s (E) when fighting her. Keep an eye out for her Conqueror and (P) stacks before fighting her.
